the done-when requires both arms from git archive extractions on node-local disk; the base arm was one, but after_suite recorded here ran from the GPFS worktree at /home/ITER/mcintos/Code/.reckon-worktrees/... and is not an extraction, so the head figure comes from a tree the done-when did not name (mitigated: the log records module.__file__ under that tree).
